title: Rollout + Analytics Standup — 2026-03-14
body:
Attendees: Marco Rivera (owner), Aisha Patel, Jenna Liu, Samir Desai, Priya Natarajan

Purpose: daily sync focused on the console rollout toggle + analytics instrumentation for the new gradual rollout flow (model variant routing + telemetry). Capture open items, owners, and immediate next steps.

Quick updates:
- UI: Jenna finished the toggle UX and edge case handling for users without RBAC. Demo available in PR (#2187). Small visual tweak requested by Product (tooltip text).
- Rollouts service: Samir pushed canary routing support to staging; traffic-splitting code mostly done but needs rate-limiter integration.
- Analytics: Aisha instrumented prefix cache-hit metric and added span attributes for model_variant and route_id. Still missing token-level latency histograms for dedicated deployments.

Notes / Discussion points:
- Telemetry schema: agreed to use label keys `model_variant`, `route_id`, `exposure_bucket` (1pct/5pct/etc). Jenna: will show `exposure_bucket` in the rollout UI for visibility.
- SLOs: target p50 < 120ms for hosted console flows; p95 < 450ms. If p95 increases > 20% over baseline for two consecutive 10m windows, the automatic rollback should trigger. Need a PromQL expression for detection (see Actions).
- Billing & Analytics join: Product wants cost-per-token by variant. Samir flagged that the serving runtime does not yet surface per-variant token counts to the billing topic. Action to add lightweight counter on the router.

Blockers:
- Rate-limiter integration (INF-4387): rollout cannot go beyond 5% without rate-limiter allowing steady-state token rate. Owner: Samir. ETA: 2026-03-18.
- Dedicated latency histograms missing for token-level tracing. Owner: Aisha. Blocked by library update in private agent (PR pending).

Decisions made:
- Canary progression policy: 1% -> 5% -> 25% -> 100% with 30m minimum at each step and 10m observation windows for metrics.
- Rollback triggers: any of the following within a 10m window relative to baseline: (a) p95 latency +20% absolute, (b) error rate > 0.5% for two consecutive windows, (c) cache-hit ratio drop > 15% leading to >10% cost increase.

Action items (short):
- Samir: wire rate-limiter into rollout controller and add per-variant token counter to billing topic (INF-4387). Due 2026-03-18.
- Aisha: finish token-level latency histograms, unblock library upgrade PR, and add example Grafana panels. Due 2026-03-16.
- Jenna: update tooltip copy, add `exposure_bucket` column to rollouts table in console, and include quick help text for SREs. Due 2026-03-15.
- Marco: draft canary runbook and include rollback commands + playbook links. Due 2026-03-15.
- Priya: add E2E smoke test that simulates variant routing and verifies metrics pipeline (CI job). Due 2026-03-20.

Instrumentation checklist (quick reference):
- [x] model_variant label on request spans
- [x] route_id label exposure in telemetry
- [ ] token_latency histogram per-model_variant (Aisha)
- [ ] per-variant token counter to billing topic (Samir)
- [x] cache_hit_ratio metric from runtime (Aisha)
- [ ] rollout exposure percent emitted to analytics (Jenna + Samir)

Sample PromQL snippets (notes):
- p95 latency (route): histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(request_duration_seconds_bucket{route_id="console",job="router"}[5m])) by (le))
- canary_error_rate: sum(rate(request_errors_total{model_variant="canary"}[5m])) / sum(rate(requests_total{model_variant="canary"}[5m]))
- token_count_per_variant (counter): increase(token_count_total{model_variant=~".*"}[30m])

Runbook / Rollout flow (practical):
1) Create rollout in console (specify variant weights, SLO thresholds).
2) Trigger 1% canary. Observe for 30m. Check p95, error rate, cache-hit ratio, cost delta.
3) If metrics OK, promote to 5% (automated wait). Repeat checks.
4) At 25% and 100% require manual sign-off from on-call SRE and product.
5) On trigger of rollback condition, console will surface a modal with one-click rollback that hits the rollout controller API and opens an incident stub.

Follow-ups for next meeting:
- Bring a short demo of the rollout modal and the canary status widget (Jenna).
- Samir to show the per-variant counter prototype and a sample billing join query.
- Aisha to present a Grafana dashboard mock with the new histograms.

Notes to self: add link to the private-deployments checklist for RBAC behavior differences (some customers use IP-based routing; need to confirm metrics pipeline handles that).

Related tickets/PRs referenced during meeting:
- INF-4321: rollout controller - traffic split config
- INF-4387: rate-limiter integration (blocking)
- GH #2187: console UI toggle PR (demo branch: feature/rollout-toggle)
